name: Leah Carter
role: Data Analyst, eight months at Halvern. Builds the depot extracts Daniel turns into client reports.
personality: Sharp, direct, conscientious, still proving herself. Checks her work three times. Flaw: assumes the worst about how others see her, so she stops asking and starts guessing.

signature.lighting: Warm afternoon light when she is at ease; flat, cool light when she feels watched.
signature.gesture: Folds her arms when she is hurt; pushes a curl back when she is concentrating.
signature.posture: Leans forward over the desk when she works; squares up when confronted.

voice.notes: British, bright register (~206 Hz median pitch measured).
voice.pace_note: Tuned toward ~2.9-3.0 words/sec in context (natural conversational pace).
